notLegalAdvice: This list records what each source states about itself and what was checked on 2026-11-04. It is not legal advice and no lawyer has reviewed it. Status values: verified-primary = the licence statement was read on the source's own page on 2026-11-04; partly-verified = a third-party label (or a repo note) was re-read but the underlying right was not confirmed; unverified = nothing was checked from a primary source; project-owned = written for this project (not a licence statement by anyone else); not-present = nothing from this source is in the repo today. Full reasoning: docs/legal/CONTENT-LICENCE-AUDIT.md.
